# Kindness Forward

> Kindness Forward is the global movement inspiring 1 billion acts of kindness during Global Kindness Season (November 1, 2026 – January 31, 2027). It grew from Pásalo Pa'lante, the Puerto Rico campaign that set a certified record of 1.1 million acts of kindness in November 2025. Te Amo PR, a U.S. 501(c)(3) nonprofit (EIN 66-0975633) based in Puerto Rico, is the parent organization of both.

Kindness Forward invites individuals, families, schools, nonprofits, companies, municipalities, and ambassadors anywhere in the world to do one act of kindness and pass it on. passkindnessforward.com is the global movement platform; pasalopalante.com is the Puerto Rico–specific platform for Pásalo Pa'lante, the campaign Kindness Forward grew out of.

- [Get involved](/get-involved): Ways individuals and organizations can participate.
- [Become an ambassador](/get-involved/ambassadors): Apply to lead kindness in your city, school, or workplace.

- [Share an act](/share): Share an act of kindness you did or received.
- [Wall of Kindness](/wall): Real stories of acts from people around the world.
- [Live broadcast](/live): The 11.11 global live kindness broadcast.
- [Kindness ideas](/ideas): Simple ideas you can do today.
- [Donate](/donate): Support the movement through Te Amo PR (tax-deductible in the U.S.).
